authority: User explicitly prioritizes boxing and says the supplied overview is rough, simplified and NOT ABSOLUTE. Styles are specialized techniques and skills. Numeric/layout examples remain provisional.

integration_map.observed: Ten-family stroke parser and keyboard/chords; body stick feeds unrestricted move; dodge keys queue timed actions. Guard/body/power modifiers already independent. LB currently owns special arm, so proposed LB-step layout conflicts.
Player has one timed command buffer and startup/recovery; boss uses authored action VM. Timer resolution asks geometric region then guard logic; sides have separate launch paths.
Timed dodge smoothly moves head and 40-percent torso, but no continuous body axis. Hit is target-centre reach/lateral/height region at resolution; no swept glove/guard intersection.
Damage, shove, guard, stagger, hitstop, knockdown and events connected. Timed dodge miss grants window without proving neutral pose was threatened; continuous-body counter causality absent.
Reads sim and events, reconstructs punch progress and post-impact pre-shove target. Region result then selects a visible endpoint, reversing required pose-to-contact authority.
Existing fixed-limb IK, plants/pivots and connected torso worth retaining. Support is presentation-owned; four archetype presets plus named silhouette overrides are not layered trained techniques.
Ground uses uniform 0.65 conversion; body height separate. contact constructs a region-fitting surface endpoint, not a committed scoring trajectory.
Third-person chase with transparent silhouette and world-oriented orbit. Does not implement embodied eye anchor.
Delegated player shares intent interface; opponent remains pattern VM with separate action scheduling. Both must eventually use shared execution and contact primitives.
Typed fighter dictionaries ride exact snapshot. New body state must participate in hash and restore; existing character ledgers must remain intact.
